entities.summary: Myōryū-ji (妙立寺), commonly known as Ninja-dera, is a Buddhist temple belonging to Nichiren sect located in the city of Kanazawa, Ishikawa, Japan. While not actually associated with ninjas, the temple earned its nickname because of its many deceptive defences. Myōryū-ji Temple is a Buddhist temple in Asia, established in 1643. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
